entries.en: Added LSP (Language Server Protocol) tool for code intelligence features like go-to-definition, find references, and hover documentation
entries.zh: 添加了 LSP（语言服务器协议）工具，用于代码智能功能，例如转到定义、查找引用和悬停文档

entries.en: Added `/terminal-setup` support for Kitty, Alacritty, Zed, and Warp terminals
entries.zh: 添加了对 Kitty、Alacritty、Zed 和 Warp 终端的`/terminal-setup`支持

entries.en: Added ctrl+t shortcut in `/theme` to toggle syntax highlighting on/off
entries.zh: 在`/theme`中添加了 ctrl+t 快捷方式以打开/关闭语法突出显示

entries.en: Added syntax highlighting info to theme picker
entries.zh: 向主题选择器添加了语法突出显示信息

entries.en: Added guidance for macOS users when Alt shortcuts fail due to terminal configuration
entries.zh: 为 macOS 用户添加了当 Alt 快捷键因终端配置而失败时的指导

entries.en: [VSCode] Added gift tag pictogram for year-end promotion message
entries.zh: [VSCode] 新增年末促销消息用的礼物标签图标

entries.en: Improved `/context` command visualization with grouped skills and agents by source, slash commands, and sorted token count
entries.zh: 改进 `/context` 的可视化：按来源对技能和代理分组，斜杠命令单独列出，token 数量排序

entries.en: Fixed skill `allowed-tools` not being applied to tools invoked by the skill
entries.zh: 修复了技能“允许的工具”未应用于该技能调用的工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed Opus 4.5 tip incorrectly showing when user was already using Opus
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 4.5 提示在用户已经使用 Opus 时错误显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed a potential crash when syntax highlighting isn't initialized correctly
entries.zh: 修复了语法突出显示未正确初始化时潜在的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed visual bug in `/plugins discover` where list selection indicator showed while search box was focused
entries.zh: 修复 `/plugins discover` 中，搜索框获得焦点时列表选中指示器仍然显示的视觉错误

entries.en: Fixed macOS keyboard shortcuts to display 'opt' instead of 'alt'
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 键盘快捷键以显示“opt”而不是“alt”
[Windows] 修复了渲染不正确的问题
